verdicts.decision_note: The client requests placement of three new bathrooms in the dwelling-division draft, establishing the Unit 2 bathroom and its architectural-plan deliverable.
The client applies a concrete bathroom partition rule requiring walls and reuse of existing walls wherever possible, including the Unit 2 bathroom.
The client explicitly centers the Unit 2 bathroom door and constrains toilet placement to avoid conflicts with existing drains; no prior attributes become obsolete.
